assistant:   A debit card takes the funds directly from your  checking account when you make a purchase. There's no loan or credit involved, it's just your money being spent.  A credit card facilitates a short term loan. When you make a purchase with a credit card, you're essentially borrowing money from the bank, which you then pay back later.
user: how do I select a credit card, there are so many choices, it is overwhelming
assistant: I understand that choosing a credit card can be overwhelming due to the variety of options available. Here are some tips that might help you: 1.  If they offer a great rewards program that encourages use, but pays too high a percentage of points earned can lead to problems. One reason why some merchants in the US don't accept Discover is that the fee the store is charged is higher than the average.
